findings.claim: The copy constructor of MessagePackSecurity no longer copies HashCollisionResistant. Any clone, such as WithMaximumObjectGraphDepth or other With* methods, silently drops hash-collision resistance and falls back to the default of false. A MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData instance cloned this way loses its collision-resistant comparers, so untrusted data can trigger hash-collision DoS. This line is unrelated to the ExcludeFromCodeCoverage requirement.

receipt_plan.detail: Call MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData.WithMaximumObjectGraphDepth(10) and assert HashCollisionResistant is true. It fails on head and passes on base. Also check that GetEqualityComparer<string>() on the clone returns a collision-resistant comparer, not the default one.
